absorption: Upstream MCP tools expose equivalent filtering, pagination/order, distance, and level result contracts.

consumers.name: MCP clients inspecting Honcho conclusions directly.

contract: MCP clients can list/query explicit, deductive, or inductive conclusions with level filtering, pagination/reverse controls, semantic distance constraints, and returned conclusion levels.

proof.fork_expected: Node typecheck passes and disposable/read-only integration proof returns the requested conclusion levels and controls.
upstream: inspect MCP conclusion list/query arguments and result fields on the recorded upstream base.
proof.upstream_expected: one or more level/pagination/distance/order controls and returned-level metadata are absent.

upstream_gap: The recorded upstream base MCP conclusion tools expose a narrower list/query surface without these local controls/result metadata.
